Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Wood Media TV Console Stand Table, 59"H, White & Gray
Materials: wood
With multiple doors, drawers and shelving, this console is ready to store dishes, books, electronics and more. White painted finish and ash veneers are paired with minimalist bronze legs, resulting in a head-turning mid-century piece. 19.7"W x 59.1"D x 30.3"H Engineered hardwood and fiberboard; metal legs Minimalist, mid-century modern design Can serve as a sideboard in a kitchen area or as a media console in the living space Assembly in 1 hour or less; screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
